configs.to: A neck size written as two equal numbers ('300 x 300') is one square neck of that size. Two different numbers are not a neck size: the item is not priced until a person sets the neck size.
configs.why: R6 L-a (owner 2026-11-26 01:14 '2 ok'; CAT-D0 D8): the neck size line on the ADP rules page

configs.to: When the heading just above names both supply and return air, and this row names neither and no damper, the damper is set to the item's usual setting, and the working says so - unless the heading itself gives the damper to both streams or to neither (owner 2026-10-23 23:24; 2026-10-24).
configs.why: R6 L-b (owner 2026-11-26 01:14 '2 ok'; CAT-D0 D8): the damper when the heading names both streams

configs.to: A cross-talk row that says 'return air baffle' also pays for one return air grille without damper - 300 x 300 where no grille size is stated - one per unit of the row; its supply and installation are added to the cross-talk's. If that grille cannot be priced, the working says so and it must be added by hand (owner 2026-10-23 23:28 / 23:29; 2026-10-24).
configs.why: R6 L-c (owner 2026-11-26 01:14 '2 ok'; CAT-D0 D8): return air baffle
